files.navigation-sidebar.css: .nav-sidebar{width:16rem;height:100%;display:grid;grid-template-rows:minmax(0,1fr) auto;background:#f8fafc;border-right:1px solid #d9e0ea}.nav-scroll{overflow:auto;padding:1rem}.nav-sidebar section{margin-bottom:1.25rem}.nav-sidebar h2{margin:0 0 .35rem;padding:0 .5rem;color:#64748b;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}.nav-sidebar button{width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;border:0;border-radius:.35rem;background:transparent;padding:.5rem;text-align:left;color:#27364a}.nav-sidebar button:hover:not(:disabled){background:#eaf0f8}.nav-sidebar button.selected{background:#dbeafe;color:#123b74;font-weight:650}.nav-sidebar button:disabled{color:#94a3b8;cursor:not-allowed}.nav-icon{width:1.1rem;text-align:center}.workspace-summary{display:grid;gap:.2rem;margin:0;padding:.75rem;border:1px solid #d9e0ea;border-radius:.45rem;background:#fff}.workspace-summary span{font-size:.82rem;color:#64748b}.nav-sidebar footer{display:flex;gap:.5rem;padding:.75rem;border-top:1px solid #d9e0ea}.nav-sidebar footer button{width:auto;flex:1;justify-content:center}
